title: Starbound Newspost now Live!
author: elastrixx
body: Welcome! This is the start of the Starbound news page! Here you'll find updates and new announcements regarding this project!
What's Starbound? Glad nobody asked! Starbound is a private Minecraft SMP i play with my friends and sometimes clip or even stream, it has it's own unique story, featuring events and more!
footnote: This is only the start of the newsletter, more will be continued to be shown and updated so stay tuned!
